role: §1983 defendant — state actor (court-connected mediator) who deprived steward of due process rights by issuing recommendation without verifiable professional qualifications
theory_of_liability: Court-connected mediator whose recommendation was adopted by Judge Delucchi, reversing protective custody structure. ZERO verifiable professional credentials found. A person who holds no valid credential to perform the function cannot claim immunity for performing it. The recommendation was the proximate cause of the custody reversal.
immunity_analysis: Court-connected mediators may claim quasi-judicial immunity. However: (1) credentialing void may pierce immunity — you cannot claim functional immunity for a function you were not qualified to perform; (2) Cal. Family Code §3164/§1815 requires master's degree + 2 years experience + DV training; (3) failure to meet statutory qualifications may remove the actor from the protected class entirely.
